تسترخصوا (form X)
# تَسْتَرْخِصُوا (tastarḵiṣū) /tas.tar.xi.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
# تُسْتَرْخَصُوا (tustarḵaṣū) /tus.tar.xa.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
